pages.title: Rocketman
pages.creator: War Space
pages.description: Rocketman launches a stunt performer from a circus cannon. Set the angle and release at the right power to bounce on trampolines, pass through hoops and collect coins. Upgrade the launch equipment and protective gear to travel farther on later attempts.

pages.title: Paddle Rush
pages.creator: Harbi Games
pages.description: Paddle Rush sends a boat along a route filled with obstacles, ramps and coins. Steer through the course and use purchased items to change its movement: peppers accelerate, anchors stop the boat and propellers let it reverse.

pages.title: Save My Human
pages.creator: Arcade Lemon
pages.description: Save My Human puts a cat in charge of rescuing its owner. Move from tile to tile through puzzle layouts, examining the dangerous paths before choosing a direction. Find a route that lets the cat reach the stranded human.

pages.title: Sniper for Brainrot
pages.creator: gameVgames
pages.description: Sniper for Brainrot combines aiming with a race against a tsunami. Shoot the balloon over a Brainrot to transform into it, then run for the safe zone. Longer shots offer rarer characters but bring a faster wave to escape.

pages.title: Meme Myth:Wukong
pages.creator: Big Wave
pages.description: Meme Myth:Wukong follows a monkey hero through absurd scene-based puzzles. Tap, drag and test objects to discover unexpected solutions, looking for details that help him survive each situation. The answers often depend on interpreting the scene's visual jokes.

pages.title: Happy Fruit Link
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Happy Fruit Link asks you to remove identical fruit tiles in pairs. Connect each pair with a line that bends no more than twice, choosing accessible routes through the remaining layout until all the tiles are cleared.

pages.title: Sid & Ginny Y2K Glam Clash
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Sid & Ginny Y2K Glam Clash lets you style two heroines with fashion inspired by the 2000s. Choose glossy makeup, hairstyles and accessories, mixing the available pieces into a separate Y2K look for each character.

pages.title: Coe Rabbit
pages.creator: Newness Games
pages.description: Coe Rabbit is a platform puzzle built around teleporting a bunny between ledges. Turn and position the rabbit, collect power-ups that adjust the portal's height and choose a route upward. Work out which teleport reaches the next useful platform.

pages.title: Stickman Mega Boss: Battles!
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Stickman Mega Boss: Battles! sends your fighter against groups of block-world mobs and large bosses. Move and attack to build combos, then buy or unbox swords and helmets. Unlock more modes as you improve the stickman's equipment.

pages.title: Colors pins
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Colors pins asks you to pack scattered pins into boxes of the same color. Select suitable pins to fill the active box, then work with its replacement. Clear every pin from the level by managing the available colors in order.

pages.title: Sprunki Jigsaw Puzzle
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Sprunki Jigsaw Puzzle includes fifteen pictures with four piece counts to choose from. Select a 16-, 36-, 64- or 100-piece layout, then arrange the scattered sections to complete the image in the shortest time you can.

pages.title: Sprunki Find The Differences
pages.creator: Caner
pages.description: Sprunki Find The Differences presents two versions of colorful Sprunki scenes. Compare them closely and tap the changed details, searching the characters, objects and backgrounds until you have located the differences required for the puzzle.

pages.title: Idle Dice 3D: Incremental Game
pages.creator: Gilvius Games
pages.description: Idle Dice 3D: Incremental Game lets you roll dice to earn coins and invest in stronger earnings. Upgrade dice with different numbers of sides and pursue useful combinations such as pairs and straights. Improved dice also generate offline income.

pages.title: Colored Bricks
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Colored Bricks asks you to slide a top brick left or right to match the color below it. A correct match clears a row and adds to your score. Remove special bricks to extend the timer and keep the round going.

pages.title: Prison Escape Online
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Prison Escape Online follows a stickman searching for a way out of jail. Try the available escape options and see where each choice leads, learning which routes are dangerous as you look for a successful path to freedom.

pages.title: Kikis Pink Christmas
pages.creator: Gamerina
pages.description: Kikis Pink Christmas lets you assemble four holiday looks for Kiki. Choose clothing for different parts of her Christmas plans, from comfortable homewear to more glamorous festive outfits. Coordinate each selection into a complete seasonal style.

pages.title: Fruitfall Catcher
pages.creator: StkngEsk
pages.description: Fruitfall Catcher challenges you to catch falling fruit while staying away from bombs. Move left and right to place yourself beneath the next safe item. Each level changes the sequence and increases the pace of the catching challenge.

pages.title: Max Mixed Cuisine
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Max Mixed Cuisine puts you alongside Max in a kitchen full of possible ingredients. Choose what to combine and experiment with different mixtures, then discover the result of the recipe. Your selections determine how the finished dish turns out.

pages.title: Crazy Color Balls
pages.creator: Immanitas Ent. GmbH
pages.description: Crazy Color Balls asks you to guide a colored character through moving arrangements of shapes. Pass through objects that match its color and avoid the others, watching the shifting formations as you work toward the end of each stage.

pages.title: Hoon or Die
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Hoon or Die follows a car through a driving chase across five maps. Steer around the route and drop bombs when needed, trying to keep the chase going. Progress toward unlocking a collection of thirty-five cars for further attempts.

pages.title: Onet Emoji connect
pages.creator: Yesbol Amirov
pages.description: Onet Emoji connect asks you to find and connect pairs of identical pictures. Select matching emojis to remove them and open more space on the board. Work through fifty levels that introduce different image sets as you advance.

pages.title: CatRobot Idle TD Battle Cat
pages.creator: KukoGames
pages.description: CatRobot Idle TD Battle puts warrior cats and a giant robot in defense of a kingdom. Aim and fire arrows at invading monsters, then strengthen your fighters and robot to face the enemies reaching the frontier.

pages.title: Grand Extreme Racing
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Grand Extreme Racing offers a championship, practice sessions and challenge races for fast cars. Drive for cups on your own or share a two-player race with a friend, using nitro and careful steering to compete on the track.

pages.title: One Escape
pages.creator: Stickman vs Monster School Team
pages.description: One Escape sends a prisoner through platforming stages on the way out of jail. Move and jump through the prison's routes, find doors and negotiate the obstacles between them. Continue the breakout through the levels toward a boss encounter.

pages.title: Spring Differences
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Spring Differences presents paired springtime pictures with small changes between them. Find and select the altered details to complete the puzzle, using a hint if needed. Finishing with more time remaining adds a bonus to the score.

pages.title: Pixel Art Challenge
pages.creator: DiHits
pages.description: Pixel Art Challenge asks you to color a grid according to a reference image. Compare the sample with your mosaic and fill the corresponding areas, choosing from several styles and difficulty settings. A free editor provides space for additional drawings.

pages.title: Epic Defense Clash
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Epic Defense Clash puts a fighter against groups of monsters using a range of weapons. Move into position and attack the enemies in front of you, choosing your actions to survive the encounters and continue through the defense battles.

pages.title: Running Santa
pages.creator: kidsgamesplay
pages.description: Running Santa follows Santa through levels filled with presents and obstacles. Jump over rocks and other hazards, use trampolines for longer leaps and collect the gifts along the platforms. Reach the finish safely to complete his delivery preparations.

pages.title: Sizes game
pages.creator: nau.kids
pages.description: Sizes game asks you to distinguish objects by how large they are. Compare the choices shown on the screen and drag the object of the requested size into place, working through the game's size-matching activities.

pages.title: Squid Game Jigsaw
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Squid Game Jigsaw offers themed pictures to rebuild at three difficulty settings. Fit the pieces together to finish an image and earn in-game currency, using the rewards to unlock additional pictures. Harder puzzle modes provide larger earnings.

pages.title: Rally Point 4
pages.creator: Xform
pages.description: Rally Point 4 sends you through off-road time trials with nitro-equipped cars. Reach the finish quickly to unlock more vehicles and tracks, balancing extra speed against engine heat. Holding nitro too long can overheat and destroy the car.

pages.title: Mega Ramp Race
pages.creator: Fat Boy Studio
pages.description: Mega Ramp Race puts a stunt car onto high, demanding ramp tracks. Steer through the obstacles and use nitro for extra speed as you tackle the course. Unlock further levels by completing the driving challenges ahead.

pages.title: Dogod.io
pages.creator: Grinding Games
pages.description: Dogod.io sends armed dogs into an arena where defeating rivals improves their weapons. Move through the fight, boost when useful and collect food and coins. Spend earnings on skins, accessories and pets while working toward higher scores.

pages.title: Flowers Blocks Collapse
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Flowers Blocks Collapse lets you remove connected groups of two or more matching flower blocks. Look for larger collapses to increase the score and use helpful power-ups. Keep the rising columns from reaching the top of the field.

pages.title: Party Animals Jigsaw
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Party Animals Jigsaw includes twelve pictures of celebrating animals. Rebuild an image from 25, 49 or 100 pieces, dragging each section into position. Choose the piece count that gives you the puzzle size you want to tackle.

pages.title: Happy Xmas
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Happy Xmas provides eight Christmas pictures and twenty-three colors for filling them. Color the selected outline quickly to work toward a higher score, choosing your own combination of shades. Save the completed picture when you are finished.

pages.creator: Game Debut
pages.description: 2048 asks you to slide numbered tiles across a four-by-four grid. Equal values merge when they meet, producing a larger number. Plan each move around the whole board so you can keep combining tiles without running out of space.

pages.title: Sports Match 3 Deluxe
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Sports Match 3 Deluxe turns sports equipment into matching tiles. Form groups of at least three identical items to reach the level's target, using helpful hourglasses and bombs along the way. Later boards make the required goals harder to complete.

pages.title: Super Race Cars Coloring
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Super Race Cars Coloring offers eight vehicle pictures to fill with a palette of twenty-three colors. Choose a car and apply your own paint scheme, trying to finish quickly for a better score. The finished image can be saved.

pages.title: Julie Dress Up
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Julie Dress Up lets you create an outfit for Julie from a selection of clothes. Try different wardrobe pieces and combine them into a complete look, changing the selections until you are happy with her finished style.

pages.title: I am an Excavator Runner
pages.creator: Pro_Gaming
pages.description: I am an Excavator Runner puts you at the controls of an excavator for a series of jobs. Learn its operation in the practice stage, complete work to earn money and unlock more tasks, then refuel and repair the machine between jobs.

pages.title: Spiral Roll
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Spiral Roll lets you shave a wooden route into curling spirals. Hold to form a roll and release to lift the tool clear of hazards, timing each stretch of carving to continue safely through the course.

pages.title: 4x4 Royal Warriors
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: 4x4 Royal Warriors asks you to reconstruct a picture on a sliding-tile board. Move a block into the adjacent empty space and plan the sequence that restores the image. Time reduces the available score, so efficient moves help preserve points.

pages.title: 2 Player Head Football
pages.creator: CD GAMES
pages.description: 2 Player Head Football lets one or two players compete with large-headed footballers. Move around the court and use bonuses that can speed up or enlarge your player, or freeze the opponent. Customize the match's players, ball and duration.

pages.title: Marching Band Jigsaw
pages.creator: Shunda Inc
pages.description: Marching Band Jigsaw presents twelve pictures with three puzzle sizes each. Choose 25, 49 or 100 pieces and fit the scattered sections into their correct positions, using the details of the image to rebuild the complete scene.

pages.title: City Helicopter Flight
pages.creator: Best Free Games
pages.description: City Helicopter Flight puts you in control of a helicopter exploring different environments. Take off, adjust altitude and steer the aircraft through the flying area, using forward movement, turning and sideways controls to guide its route.

pages.title: Desert Gun
pages.creator: JZJO.COM
pages.description: Desert Gun turns the desert into a shooting range with targets appearing for a gunner. Aim and fire to hit them, building the score needed to reach the next level as the target arrangements change.

pages.title: Solve it Colors Game
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Solve it Colors Game asks you to move colored circles toward their matching square destinations. Click a circle to send it in the direction of its arrow, planning the sequence so the pieces reach their goals without hitting other shapes.

pages.title: Buggy Simulator
pages.creator: Online Games io
pages.description: Buggy Simulator gives you several buggies and four different maps to explore. Drive freely through each environment, use boost for extra speed and experiment with the terrain. Camera changes and reset controls help you set up another run.

pages.title: Christmas Decor
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Christmas Decor lets you help Ella and Mia prepare a hall for their Christmas party. Find the decorative items and arrange the venue, then choose outfits for both princesses so they are ready for the celebration.

pages.title: Christmas Runner
pages.creator: JZJO.COM
pages.description: Christmas Runner sends Santa through a running course to gather gifts. Guide his jumps and sideways movement around the hazards, collecting items along the route and keeping him moving safely through the holiday-themed run.

pages.title: Dream Boyfriend Maker
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Dream Boyfriend Maker focuses on creating and dressing a male character. Browse the available clothes and put together a complete outfit, experimenting with the fashion selections to design the appearance you want for your dream boyfriend.

pages.title: Stack Tower
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Stack Tower challenges you to build stable structures from shapes of different sizes. Aim each piece and release it onto the stack, judging its landing position so the growing tower stays intact until the level's building is complete.

pages.title: Christmas Carols Jigsaw
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Christmas Carols Jigsaw offers twelve seasonal images to assemble from scattered pieces. Choose a puzzle with 25, 49 or 100 pieces and reconstruct the selected picture, matching its outlines and details until the Christmas scene is complete.

pages.title: Triumph Rocket 3 Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Triumph Rocket 3 Puzzle features six pictures of the motorcycle in four jigsaw sizes. Reassemble a selected image using 16, 36, 64 or 100 pieces, fitting the bike and background sections together to finish the puzzle.

pages.title: Euro Truck Driving Sim 2018 3D
pages.creator: Best Free Games
pages.description: Euro Truck Driving Sim 2018 3D puts a truck on wintry roads for a driving simulation. Steer along the icy route and manage the vehicle's movement with acceleration and braking, using the handbrake when you need to control its position.

pages.title: Halloween Slide Puzzle 2
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Halloween Slide Puzzle 2 turns three Halloween images into sliding puzzles. Select one of three modes and rearrange the picture's tiles, planning how to shift the sections into their correct places to restore the complete scene.

pages.title: Halloween Ball Challenge
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Halloween Ball Challenge sends patterned balls along conveyor belts. Find the indicated balls when they appear as a pair and click them to score before the timer expires. Collect a ten-second power-up to extend the round.

pages.title: Boxing fighter : Super punch
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Boxing fighter : Super punch puts a boxer between attackers arriving from both sides. Strike the approaching opponents and bosses with different punches, then unlock extra moves to increase your fighting options as the crowd grows.

pages.title: Baby Hazel Learn Colors
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Baby Hazel Learn Colors follows Hazel through several color activities. Help with a doll makeover, prepare colored frosting and choose shades for a picture, responding to her requests as she practices identifying and using different colors.

pages.title: Jelly Shift2
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Jelly Shift2 challenges you to reshape a moving jelly to fit the opening ahead. Use the up and down controls to change its proportions, judging the available space before the jelly reaches the next obstacle.

pages.title: Gangster City Crime
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Gangster City Crime puts you into city-based action across two modes and several levels. Move, jump and use attacks against opponents, blocking when you need protection. Work through the encounters using the character's close-combat controls.

pages.title: Bff Princess Tatoo Shop
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Bff Princess Tatoo Shop follows Mia as her friends visit her new tattoo studio. Help choose a tattoo design for each visitor, comparing the available artwork and selecting a style suited to the friend receiving it.

pages.title: Animal Kingdom Match 3
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Animal Kingdom Match 3 asks you to arrange matching animal tiles into rows of at least three. Make combinations to earn points and keep the side gauge from draining too far, continuing the round by finding the next useful match.

pages.title: Sleepy Princess Pregnant Check Up
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Sleepy Princess Pregnant Check Up lets you help with a princess's virtual prenatal appointment. Use the clinic's tools to listen to a heartbeat and view an ultrasound, then finish the visit by choosing a decorative belly tattoo.

pages.title: Ben Car Jigsaw
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Ben Car Jigsaw offers twelve themed vehicle pictures at three difficulty settings. Select a 25-, 49- or 100-piece puzzle and fit its scattered sections together, working through the details until the complete picture is restored.

pages.title: EG Plumber
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: EG Plumber asks you to connect two water points before the time allowance ends. Arrange the pipe route so water can drain between them, working through thirty levels with increasingly complicated layouts to solve.

pages.title: Hurry Pen
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Hurry Pen follows a pen along a route that depends on its remaining ink. Guide it onward and replenish the ink supply to keep going, watching the ink bar as you work toward extending the run.

pages.title: Panda Simulator
pages.creator: CyberGoldfinch
pages.description: Panda Simulator follows a panda building a life in a forest shared with predators. Explore, perform tasks for other pandas and improve your home. Create a family and care for cubs as you develop the panda's surroundings.

pages.title: Fashion Girl New Dress
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Fashion Girl New Dress gives one girl three events that each need a different outfit. Browse the clothing choices and style a suitable look for each occasion, comparing combinations before settling on her three finished outfits.

pages.title: Sky Castle
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Sky Castle asks you to build upward by stacking castle sections. Tap when the next piece is aligned and try to keep each placement steady. As the castle grows taller, fitting the following blocks becomes more demanding.

pages.title: Fruit Master Online
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Fruit Master Online challenges you to throw knives through groups of fruit. Time a release to slice several fruits at once for bonus points, completing levels to make cocktails. Earn coins and wheel rewards to unlock other throwing objects.

pages.title: Flow Laser Quest
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Flow Laser Quest asks you to join points of the same color in a digital puzzle world. Work out a route for each connection and continue through a hundred levels, considering how the remaining points can be linked before committing to a path.

pages.title: Plane GO
pages.creator: Dob5 Games
pages.description: Plane GO sends a plane through four worlds filled with stars. Collect the ordinary stars to unlock the super star needed to win each stage, then face the bosses across forty levels in grass, ice, sand and space settings.

pages.title: Pinata Muncher
pages.creator: Kizi
pages.description: Pinata Muncher follows an animal hungry for sweets from star-shaped piñatas. Break as many piñata stars as you can at speed to release the treats, continuing the smashing activity to gather more of the animal's candy.

pages.title: LavaNoid
pages.creator: Piponga
pages.description: LavaNoid combines paddle-and-ball block breaking with cardboard-styled monsters. Return the ball into the field to smash blocks, collecting helpful effects along the way. Keep the ball in play as you work to clear each level's arrangement.

pages.title: Good vs Bad Girl
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Good vs Bad Girl lets you explore two different styles for Ladybug. Choose a hero costume and an everyday outfit from the available clothing, combining pieces that help decide whether her finished appearance looks good or mischievous.

pages.title: Tomboy Creator
pages.creator: Missangest Games
pages.description: Tomboy Creator lets you design a character and dress her in a tomboy-inspired outfit. Combine the available appearance and clothing choices into a complete look, trying different selections until the character matches the style you want.

pages.title: Mini Realife Sauna
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Mini Realife Sauna follows a Mini preparing to join friends in a sauna. Remove jewelry, shave his beard and change his outfit before entering. Help create steam during the visit, then continue with the game's dressing activity.

pages.title: Forest Creature
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Forest Creature gives a magical character a makeover. Explore the available appearance choices and combine them into a new look, trying different selections until you have a finished style for the creature in its forest setting.

pages.title: Hero Vs Villain!
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Hero Vs Villain! follows Ladybug after a rooftop pursuit damages her costume. Help her choose a replacement hero outfit and a separate everyday look, combining the wardrobe options to get her ready for what comes next.

pages.title: Sweet Kitty Dream Dress!
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Sweet Kitty Dream Dress! lets you create a dress for Sweet Kitty. Choose the outfit's style and coordinate its details, trying different design combinations until the character has a finished dress suited to the look you imagined.

pages.title: Wonderful Wedding Cakes
pages.creator: igirlgames
pages.description: Wonderful Wedding Cakes puts you in charge of decorating a wedding cake. Choose from the available cake decorations and arrange them into a coordinated design, building the appearance of the centerpiece for an imagined wedding celebration.

pages.title: Princess Castle Festival
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Princess Castle Festival lets you style five princesses for an event at the castle. Choose dresses and coordinate colors, patterns and other fashion details, giving each princess a distinct finished outfit for the festival.
